anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: 3–5 L. ca. 18 Z. Restoration from Pr I12.
Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: see that you make everything according to the type shown on the mountain.
Shadow of the things to come.

pass_a_gloss: which besides the type of the mysteries also shows an intelligible contemplation, of which we shall speak later. For that the law is a shadow and type, the oracle shows saying: See you shall make all things according to the type of the tent shown you in the mountain.
pass_b_english: which, besides the type of the mysteries, also shows an intelligible contemplation, of which we shall speak later. For that the law is a shadow and a type, the oracle shows, saying: "See that you make everything according to the type of the tent that was shown you on the mountain." (Hebrews 8:5) (Exodus 25:40) (Hebrews 10:1) (Colossians 2:17)
source_text: ... [ὅπερ πρὸς τῷ τύπῳ τῶν μυστικῶν καὶ νοητὴν θεωρίαν δηλοῖ, περὶ ἧς ὕστερον ἐροῦμεν· τὸ γὰρ σκιὰν εἶναι τὸν νόμον καὶ τύπον, δηλοῖ φάσκον τὸ λόγιον· "Ὅρα ποιήσεις πάντα κατὰ τὸν τύπον τῆς σκηνῆς τὸν δειχθέντα σοι ἐν τῷ ὄρει."]
